title: ConstructInvocationEnvelope
description: Per-stage invocation envelope for the Construct Bounded-Context Runtime Substrate (cycle-construct-bounded-context, SDD §3.1). Captures everything a runner needs to execute a single construct stage: identity, domain claim, mode, input streams, allowed context, isolation policy, output contract, and hash-chain linkage. Schema version: v0 (initial). Future versions append fields under additionalProperties:false in extension blocks; breaking changes bump to v1.

schema_version.description: Schema id literal. Bumping requires migration runbook (FR-1.4).

run_id.description: Per-run identifier. Stable across all stages of a single composition execution.

composition_id.description: Deterministic composition identity per FR-1.5 / SDD §3.1. Format: '{basename(path)}@sha256:{first_12_chars(sha256(jcs_canonicalize(yaml_content)))}'. Stable across formatting changes; unstable across semantic changes.

stage_id.description: Per-stage identifier within a composition. Pattern: '<composition-slug>.stage-<n>'. FR-5.1: included in persistent-state composite key to prevent same-skill-multi-stage collisions.

stage_pass.description: Iteration pass counter. 1 = first run; >1 = re-entry under composition.iterate. Distinct from cycle_count in run state.

slug.description: Pack slug (lowercase, hyphen-separated). Must resolve in installed pack registry.

persona.description: Optional persona handle (e.g. 'ALEXANDER', 'STAMETS'). Free-form per composition.schema.json convention.

primary.description: Stage's bounded-context primary tag. SDD §3.1: must align with construct manifest unless explicitly overridden by composition.

active_language.description: Ubiquitous-language tokens active at this stage.

invariants.description: Domain invariants the construct asserts; auditable surface.

mode.description: Stage execution mode. 'fresh' = clean subprocess, no prior context (SDD §2.1). 'persistent' = teammate accumulates context across iterations (FR-7). 'blocking' = stage halts the chain on emit, awaits operator continuation.

input_streams.description: Hash-pinned upstream stream references this stage will read.

allowed_context.description: Whitelisted context buckets the runner may surface to the construct. Beyond these, surfacing is forbidden (FR-13.2).

operator_model.description: Operator-model context per cycle-098 Operator-Model stream.

context_policy.description: Per-stage isolation contract. Strict-tier runners enforce kernel-side; advisory-tier runners enforce cooperatively (SDD §6.5b).

include_prior_transcript.description: If false, prior LLM transcript is not surfaced (FR-4.3 leak vector 1).

include_unread_stage_outputs.description: If false, only declared input_streams are accessible — no peek at sibling stage outputs.

include_unlisted_grimoires.description: If false, only files in allowed_read_paths are surfaced from grimoires/.

allowed_read_paths.description: Path globs the construct may read. Strict tier enforces via bwrap --ro-bind; advisory via LD_PRELOAD/dyld interposition + cooperative check.

allowed_write_paths.description: Path globs the construct may write. Strict tier enforces via bwrap --bind; advisory via post-exec output validator + cooperative check.

allowed_env_vars.description: Env var allowlist. Subprocess runs under env -i + only these names passed through (FR-4.1).

allow_network.description: Master toggle for network egress. When false, allowed_egress MUST be [].

allowed_egress.description: Host:port allowlist for network egress. Strict tier enforces via Linux netns + CONNECT proxy (SDD §2.3); advisory via HTTP_PROXY env (HTTP/HTTPS-aware code only). When allow_network is false, this MUST be empty.

llm_session_strategy.description: Per-stage LLM session policy. 'fresh' = new session id + provider memory disable verified (strict) or attempted (advisory). 'continue' = explicit opt-in to reuse, banned in mode:fresh stages.

allowed_mcp_tools.description: MCP tool allowlist enforced via cheval adapter.

network_namespace.description: Linux-only opt-in to spawn under --unshare-net. Required for strict-tier network claims; ignored on macOS/Windows (advisory only).

isolation_tier.description: Tier under which this stage will run. Resolved from .claude/data/construct-validation-tiers.yaml at composition load time. Strict = kernel-enforced; compatibility = generated-contract-enforced; advisory = warn-only.

network_isolation_class.description: Captured at envelope build time so handoff and audit can attest the actual isolation class achieved (NOT what was requested). 'kernel' = bwrap+netns; 'cooperative' = HTTP_PROXY-aware; 'none' = no enforcement.

output_contract.description: Declared writes the stage promises to produce (FR-11). Post-exec validator enforces (SDD §4.4).

required.description: FR-11.1: count enforcement. If true, missing output → [OUTPUT-CONTRACT-VIOLATION].

domain.description: Optional domain attribution metadata for cross-stage tracing (S0-T8).

audit_signed.description: FR-6 / SDD §6.3: opt-in to cycle-098 audit_emit_signed. When true, runtime requires bootstrapped audit keys (pre-flight gate).

prev_hash.description: Hash chain linkage per SDD §3.1. null for first invocation; otherwise sha256 of prior-stage handoff envelope (JCS-canonicalized).

invocation_hash.description: Self-hash. Computed via two-pass: canonicalize envelope WITHOUT this field, sha256 the canonical JSON, set this field to the result.

uri.description: Path or URI of the stream payload.

hash.description: Content-addressed integrity check; re-hashed at run time.

domain.description: Optional domain attribution carried with the stream reference (S0-T8).
